items.t: China's Auto Industry Faces a Wave of New Models and Deals
items.s: A busy week in China's car market brought nine new model launches, a major restructuring between two state-owned automakers, and a shift in the Huawei-Seres partnership, signaling intensifying competition and consolidation.

items.t: One Day, Nine New Cars: Inside China's Crowded EV Market
items.s: On September 23, nine new models from brands like Geely, Changan and Denza hit Chinese showrooms in a single day. The pile-up reflects brutal competition in the world's largest car market, where too many models chase too few buyers.
